text: . Renowned Nepali mountaineer Nirmal Purja, who captivated the world with his record-breaking ascent of all 14 of the planet’s 8,000-metre peaks in just over six months, died in an avalanche on Broad Peak in Pakistan occupied territory of Gilgit-Baltistan. He was 43.Purja was among a 10-member expedition team attempting to summit Broad Peak when an avalanche struck on last Thursday. His death was confirmed today by Elite Exped, the expedition company. Pakistani mountaineering authorities said four bodies were recovered from the mountain yesterday.

. President Droupadi Murmu today interacted with a group of grassroots innovators from the Atal Innovation Mission at Rashtrapati Bhavan and witnessed their innovations in an exhibition. During the meeting, the President emphasised that grassroots innovations are well-suited to society’s needs, as they combine local experience, scientific thinking, and individual creativity with a sense of social responsibility. President Murmu also appreciated the efforts of the innovators for working with conviction despite challenges to bring about positive change in the lives of individuals, families, and communities.

. Government e Marketplace (GeM) today launched the 10-day celebrations ahead of its 10th Foundation Day. The event also witnessed the unveiling of the official GeM 10th Foundation Day logo, symbolising a decade of its journey in building India’s trusted digital public procurement ecosystem. Addressing the gathering, Chief Executive Officer of GeM, Mihir Kumar, reflected on the organisation’s transformative journey over the past ten years and outlined its vision for the next phase of growth, innovation and stakeholder-centric public procurement.The Ministry of Commerce and Industry said, the launch of the celebrations marks the beginning of a year-long series of stakeholder engagement initiatives and outreach programmes across the country. The Ministry noted that GeM will also organise a Buyer Meet on 5th and a Seller Roundtable on 10th of the next month. The occasion will honour distinguished buyers and sellers for their exemplary contributions to strengthening the GeM ecosystem.

. Indian boxers Jaismine Lamboria and Preeti Pawar won gold medals in their respective final bouts at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow today.Preeti claimed the gold with a dominant 5-nil victory over Canada’s Scarlett Delgado in the women’s 54kg before reigning world champion Jaismine clinched the yellow metal in women’s 57kg with the same scoreline against Northern Ireland’s Michaela Walsh, who was the defending champion.Indian triple jumper Praveen Chitravel won silver while Selva Prabhu bagged bronze medal in Commonwealth Games.India is currently placed 6th in the overall medal standings with 27 medals-seven gold, 13 silver and seven bronze.

. The Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) special swap facility has mobilised 40.81 billion dollars in foreign exchange inflows as of yesterday, nearly doubling the 20.71 billion dollars recorded as of July 17, indicating continued strong response to the central bank’s measures to encourage foreign currency inflows and strengthen the country’s balance of payments.According to the latest RBI data, Foreign Currency Non-Resident Bank, FCNRB deposits accounted for the bulk of the inflows at 36.72 billion dollars, while Overseas Foreign Currency Borrowings OFCBs contributed 2.57 billion dollars. External Commercial Borrowings (ECBs) mobilised a further 1.5 billion dollars.
. In the forex market today, the rupee appreciated by 29 paise to end at 95 rupees and 39 paise against the US dollar.

. India will have multiple medal opportunities at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow today, with boxing taking centre stage as a record 10 Indian pugilists, led by Olympic medallist Lovlina Borgohain, compete in their respective finals. All 10 Indian boxers secured victories in the semi-finals yesterday, guaranteeing at least silver medals and marking India’s best-ever boxing performance at the Commonwealth Games. They will now aim to convert their silver medals into gold at the SEC Centre.Among women finalists are Lovlina Borgohain in 75kg, Sakshi Chaudhary in 51kg, Preeti Pawar in 54kg, Jaismine Lamboria in 57kg, Priya Ghanghas in 60kg and Arundhati Choudhary in 70kg. In Men’s section, Jadumani Singh Mandengbam will fight in 55kg, Sachin Siwach in 60kg, Ankush Panghal in 80kg and Narender Berwal will appear in 90 plus kg category.India’s judokas will also be in action after Asmita Dey and Harsh Singh won the country’s first-ever Commonwealth Games judo gold medals yesterday. In women’s category, Unnati Sharma in 63kg and Inunganbi Takhellambam in 70kg and in men’s category, Karanjit Singh Maan in 90kg and Harsh Tokas in 81kg category will begin their campaigns.In lawn bowls, the men’s pairs team of Navneet Singh and Dinesh Kumar will face England in a must-win sectional match, with the winner advancing to the semi-finals. India will also compete for medals in para athletics and track cycling.

. The Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA) has facilitated the first-ever air shipment of Neelam and Totapuri mangoes from Karnataka to the Maldives. The Ministry of Commerce and Industry has said, the mango export initiative delivers over 50 per cent higher returns to farmers compared to conventional market channels. It added that the export marks a significant milestone in promoting Karnataka’s late-season mango varieties in international markets and further strengthening India’s mango export basket.Neelam mango is widely appreciated for its sweet, juicy pulp, rich aroma and suitability for desserts, smoothies and beverages, while Totapuri mango is known for its distinctive shape, sweet-tangy flavour and versatility for both fresh consumption and processing. Harvested from late June to the end of July, these late-season varieties offer an opportunity to extend India’s mango export season and cater to international demand beyond the peak harvest period.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will launch the ‘Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp’ Abhiyan today through video conferencing. The launch will mark the beginning of a 100-week nationwide Jan Bhagidari campaign against substance abuse. Youth across the country from over 10,000 locations will participate in the programme.MY Bharat Volunteers, MY Bharat National Service Scheme volunteers, youth clubs, schools, colleges, universities, NGOs, youth wings of industry associations and more than 125 partner spiritual organisations will also join the programme virtually. Under the campaign, weekly activities will be organised every Sunday across the country to promote awareness and encourage public participation in building a drug-free society.The activities will include sports events, walkathons, meditation sessions, cultural programmes, awareness campaigns, nukkad nataks, discussion forums, art competitions and community engagement programmes. The initiative aims to inspire youth to stay away from substance abuse and encourage them to become ambassadors of positive social change in their communities.

. Uzbekistan’s Minister for Foreign Affairs, Saidov Bakhtiyor Odilovich, will undertake an official visit to India from today until the 5th August. According to the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), during his visit, Odilovich will call on President Droupadi Murmu at Rashtrapati Bhavan and also meet External Affairs Minister (EAM) Dr. S Jaishankar. He is scheduled to attend a business forum in Delhi.

. Union Home Minister Amit Shah paid tribute to Pingali Venkayya on his birth anniversary today. In a social media post, the Minister said that Pingali Venkayya made an immortal contribution to designing the national flag Tiranga, which flutters high as the symbol of India’s pride and aspirations. Mr Shah noted that his role in the independence movement and development of different streams of knowledge will always inspire Indians.

. The European Union will hold emergency talks on Aug 5 to address the migration crisis in Ceuta, following a dispute between Spain and some member states. 22 EU countries have called for a coordinated response and stronger external border controls after around 60,000 migrants entered the Spanish enclave from Morocco.Spain has criticised what it called a polarising response from some European governments after Italy suspended the EU’s border-free Schengen arrangement with Spain, a move supported by Finland and Denmark. Officials said nearly all migrants who entered Ceuta on July 30 have since returned, while at least 67 people have died during the surge in crossings.The EU countries warned that uncontrolled migration could undermine confidence in the bloc’s common migration policy. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez said his government had restored control of the border and prevented unauthorised movement into mainland Europe.

. India climbed to fourth place in the Commonwealth Games 2026 medal standings in Glasgow following a remarkable Day 10, securing 16 medals on Saturday. This surge brought India’s tally to 39 medals, comprising 13 gold, 17 silver, and 9 bronze, with the boxing contingent leading the charge.India finished atop the boxing medal table, achieving its best-ever performance at the Commonwealth Games with a record seven gold and three silver medals. Among the gold medallists, Ankush Panghal defeated England’s Dimeji Shittu 4-1 in the men’s 80kg final, while Sachin Siwach edged past Namibia’s Tryagain Morning Ndevelo 3-2 to claim the men’s 60kg title. The other Indian boxing gold medallists included Jaismine Lamboria, Preeti Pawar, Sakshi Chaudhary, Priya Ghanghas, and Arundhati Choudhary.Three Indian boxers, Narender Berwal, Olympic medallist Lovlina Borgohain, and Jadumani Singh, settled for silver medals. Narender lost to England’s Damar Thomas by a unanimous decision in the men’s 90+kg final. Lovlina went down 4-1 to Australia’s Emma-Sue Greentree in the women’s 75kg final. Preeti claimed the women’s 54-kilogram boxing title with a commanding 5-0 victory over Canada’s Scarlett Delgado. Jaismine, the reigning world champion, secured another 5-0 win in the women’s 57-kilogram final, defeating Michaela Walsh of Northern Ireland.Sakshi then beat Ruby White of England in the women’s 51-kilogram final 5-0 to win. It was a harder final bout for Priya, who beat Marie-Bathoul Al-Ahmadieh of Canada 4-1 in a split verdict in the women’s 60-kilogram final. Arundhati Choudhary also defeated Chantelle Reid of England in the women’s 70-kilogram final.Long-distance runner Gulveer Singh has scripted history at the Commonwealth Games, winning bronze in the men’s 5,000 metres after a silver in the 10,000 metres. He becomes the first Indian track and field athlete to win two medals in a single edition of the Games and the first Indian to claim a Commonwealth medal in the 5,000 metres. The reigning Asian champion clocked 13 minutes 24.95 seconds to complete a historic double.India also celebrated a historic achievement in para-athletics, with Soman Rana winning gold and Shubham Juyal taking silver in the men’s shot put F57 event. This result marked India’s first-ever Commonwealth Games gold medal in the men’s shot put F57 event and the nation’s first double podium finish in the category.In the men’s triple jump event, Praveen Chithravel won silver, while Selva Prabhu Thirumaran clinched bronze.On the judo mat, Unnati Sharma clinched the women’s 63kg bronze medal after defeating Skye Knoester of South Africa by Ippon in the third-place contest.Karanjit Singh Maan reached the men’s -90kg quarter-finals with an ippon win over New Zealand’s Elliott Connolly before suffering defeats to Canada’s Guillaume Gaulin in the last eight and Scotland’s Scott Cuscak in the repechage.

. Rajya Sabha has passed the Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Bill, 2026. The bill will further amend the Prevention of Insults to National Honour Act, 1971. The proposed legislation seeks to give Vande Mataram the same statutory protection as the national anthem, Jana Gana Mana. These offences are punishable with imprisonment up to three years, a fine, or both.Replying to a discussion on the Bill, Minister of State for Home Nityanand Rai said, the amendment in the Bill is not merely a legislative change. He said, it reflects the collective commitment to the soul of India, national consciousness, cultural heritage, and the ideals of the freedom struggle.The Minister said, in 1971, through the Prevention of Insults to National Honour Act, provisions were made to ensure respect for the National Flag, the Constitution, and the National Anthem, Jana Gana Mana. Mr Rai said, the deliberate insult of Vande Mataram will be punishable in the same manner as provided under the existing law. The National Song Vande Mataram was composed in 1875 by Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay. The Minister claimed that in 1935, when Jawaharlal Nehru became the President of the Congress, he limited Vande Mataram to only two stanzas. On the other hand, in 1928, when Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose was Congress President, he requested Timir Baran Banerjee to prepare a complete and dignified musical version of the song. He said, on 15th August 1947, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel had asked Pandit Omkarnath Thakur to render the complete Vande Mataram on All India Radio at 6:30 in the morning, marking the beginning of the first Independence Day.The Minister said, on 24th January 1950, Dr. Rajendra Prasad stated in the Constituent Assembly that Vande Mataram, which holds historic importance in India’s freedom struggle, would be accorded the same respect as Jana Gana Mana. Mr Rai said opposing Vande Mataram reflects a policy of appeasement that undermines the nation’s pride.Earlier, initiating the discussion, BJP MP Dr Radha Mohan Das Agrawal said that for the past 123 years, Vande Mataram song had been disrespected. He stated that inspired by this song, the revolutionaries of the country made sacrifices for the nation. Mr Agrawal alleged that in 1923, during a Congress session, the then President of the Congress had insulted Vande Mataram.Golla Baburao of YSRCP requested all the Members of this House to uphold and respect the national song. He expressed his gratitude to the Government for introducing this Bill. Mr Baburao said that Vande Mataram is not just a song, but a source of inspiration that motivated countless freedom fighters to sacrifice their lives for the nation. He said, the spirit generated by this song played a significant role in the country’s struggle for independence. Sulata Deo of BJD, Sanjay Singh of AAP, Dr M Thambidurai of AIADMK, among others, participated in the discussion.After the passing of the Bill, the Upper House took up Special Mentions, where Members raised issues of urgent importance. After that, Rajya Sabha was adjourned till 11 AM tomorrow.

. Global crude oil prices rose today. Brent crude was trading 1.4 per cent up at 90 US dollars and 25 cents per barrel in intra-day trade. West Texas Intermediate crude was trading 2.6 per cent up at 85 US dollars and 77 cents per barrel, when reports last came in.

. President Droupadi Murmu has congratulated Judo player Yamini Maurya for clinching the Silver Medal in the women’s 57-kg Judo event at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026. In a social media post, the President said, Yamini’s podium finish has earned India its third judo medal at the Games, reflecting the country’s growing excellence in the sport. President Murmu praised the judoka’s resilience, determination and fighting spirit, saying that her achievement has made the nation proud. The President expressed confidence that Yamini’s inspiring journey would motivate many more young judokas across the country to strive for excellence.Meanwhile, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has congratulated Yamini Maurya on winning the Silver Medal in the Women’s 57-kg Judo event at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026. In a social media post, the Prime Minister said, Yamini’s passion for judo was clearly reflected in her performance. Mr Modi expressed confidence that her achievement will inspire many youngsters to take up the sport in the coming years.

. President Droupadi Murmu flagged off a run ‘PBG Soldierathon’ at a ceremony held at the Forecourt of Rashtrapati Bhavan this morning. Governor of Mizoram General VK Singh who is the patron of the initiative was also present on the occasion.In a social media post, the President said that the Soldierathon serves as a unique platform to strengthen the bond between civilians and the Armed Forces, guided by the vision of ‘Run for Soldiers, Run with Soldiers’. Centred on the theme ‘Supporting Real Heroes – the Armed Forces of India,’ the event pays tribute to the dedication, courage and sacrifice of the nations soldiers while encouraging citizens to express their solidarity with them through active participation.

. In tennis, India’s Ramkumar Ramanathan and Vijay Sundar Prashanth clinched the doubles title at the Bonn Open 2026 today.The unseeded Indians defeated England’s Scott Duncan and Sweden’s Adam Heinonen 7-6(4), 6-3 in the one-hour, 31-minute final.They had stormed into the final after securing a 6-2, 6-3 victory over Ignacio Carou and Federico Agustin Gomez in the semi-finals.This title marks Ramkumar’s second ATP Challenger doubles trophy of the year, after his triumph at the Texas Spine and Joint Challenger Men’s Championship in June with fellow Indian Rithvik Bollipalli. 31-year-old Ramkumar has now won 13 ATP Challenger titles in his career.

. In Ukraine, at least nine people were killed and 22 others injured after Russia launched a massive overnight barrage of ballistic missiles and drones on the capital, Kyiv. According to Ukraine’s State Emergency Service, falling debris damaged a five-storey residential building in the Solomianskyi district, triggering a fire.Rescue teams evacuated 35 residents from the upper floors. Two people were killed and eight others were injured in the district. In Kyiv’s Darnytskyi district, seven people were killed and 14 others injured as the attack sparked fires and damaged residential buildings, vehicles, administrative offices and other non-residential structures.Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said he spoke with U.S. Vice President JD Vance and discussed his meeting with President Donald Trump earlier this week in Washington, which he described as positive and productive. The latest attack came just two days after another large-scale Russian missile and drone strike across Ukraine killed 10 civilians and injured more than 50 others.

. The government has said that the country became free from Left Wing Extremism after nearly six decades of violence, which was once considered one of the biggest threats to internal security.In reply to a question in the Rajya Sabha,  Minister of State for Home Affairs Nityanand Rai said that this has been achieved with resolute implementation of the National Policy and Action Plan to address Left-Wing Extremism 2015 and the coordinated efforts of Centre and State governments. He informed the House that at present, no district is categorized as LWE affected. Mr Rai added that the number of Naxal-affected districts reduced from 126 to 90 in April 2018, 70 in July 2021, 38 in April 2024, 8 in December 2025 and zero in March 2026.The Minister also informed that  at present, 37 districts are categorized as Legacy and Thrust districts, which are no more LWE affected, but continued support regarding security and development measures is required for some more time to consolidate the position. He informed that one district has been kept under the category of District of Concern where LWE violent activities have been totally contained and their organizational structure has been completely dismantled.The Minister said that in the post-LWE scenario, the focus is on saturation of government welfare programmes, strengthening local self-governance, facilitating the rehabilitation of surrendered cadres and expanding the reach of governance and public services in remote areas. Mr Rai said that overall, Centre is committed for ensuring security and accelerated development of erstwhile LWE affected districts of the country.

. US President Donald Trump has threatened to intensify military action against Iran, warning that American strikes will continue until Tehran halts attacks on shipping and returns to negotiations. The escalating hostilities come even as the US State Department issued a fresh security advisory urging Americans in West Asia to consider leaving the region or be prepared to depart if the conflict worsens.The renewed tensions also spilled into Gaza and Lebanon, with Israel carrying out fresh strikes despite Hamas announcing it was prepared to disarm under a US-backed ceasefire framework. Meanwhile, Iran has warned that it is ready to strike key Israeli infrastructure and American energy facilities across the West Asia if it comes under attack.Iranian State media quoted a senior Iranian security official saying Tehran has prepared plans to target critical installations in Israel and US energy assets across the region if any military action is launched against the country. The official also said Iran’s armed forces had demonstrated their capability during the recent 40-day conflict and subsequent military engagements.

. Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections in the last month witnessed a significant rise to 2,11,205 crore rupees, marking a 15.4 percent year-on-year increase from 1,83,065 crore rupees in July 2025. According to the provisional data released by the Finance Ministry, Gross domestic GST revenue stood at 1,44,695 crore rupees, up 10.1 per cent from a year ago. GST collections from imports surged 28.8 per cent to 66,511 crore rupees, providing a boost to the overall monthly mop-up.

. In Taipei Open Badminton, India’s Tanvi Sharma stormed into the Women’s Singles final with a commanding victory in the semi-final today. The 17-year-old outclassed Chinese Taipei’s Huang Yu-Hsun, 21-17, 21-11 in straight games to book her place in the title clash. Tanvi will now take on Vietnam’s World No. 21, Thuy Linh Nguyen, in the final. However, Unnati Hooda bowed out in the semi-final after suffering a 15-21, 18-21 defeat to Thuy Linh Nguyen.

. The government has said that there are no dues pertaining to any of the States and Union Territories are pending under Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar and Aajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB-G RAM G) Scheme till date. Minister of State for Rural Development Kamlesh Paswan said in reply to a question in the Rajya Sabha that the Viksit Bharat-G RAM G) Act, 2025 came into force with effect from 1st of this month in rural areas of the entire country. He said, all States and UTs have notified the VB G RAM G Scheme and have started implementing it.Mr Paswan said, the Government continuously monitors the implementation of the VB-G RAM G Scheme through the Management Information System, regular review meetings and other appropriate mechanisms. The Minister added that the budgetary allocation of over 95 thousand crore rupees has been made for the Scheme during the Financial  year 2026-27. He added that this is among the largest ever allocation made at the Budget Estimate Stage for any rural employment scheme in the history of the country.

. In Ukraine, three people were killed and over 12 others are injured after Russia launched an overnight missile and drone attack on Kyiv. Mayor of Kyiv Vitalii Klitschko said, a five-storey residential building in the Solomianskyi district was damaged by falling debris, with people believed to be trapped inside. A fire also broke out in the courtyard. He said another residential building in the Shevchenkivskyi district partially collapsed, leaving more people trapped.The attack came two days after a large-scale Russian missile and drone strike across Ukraine killed 10 civilians and injured more than 50 others. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has renewed his call for more Patriot air defence systems from the United States and other Western allies to help counter Russian missile attacks.

. Cross-border trade between India and China through the Nathu La pass in Sikkim has resumed from this morning, ending a suspension of more than six years. The resumption marks a positive sign in bilateral engagement between India and China. Our correspondent reports, officials from both India and China met on the No Man’s Land this morning. The Chinese side was represented by Administrative head from the Tibet Autonomous Region, including representatives of its commerce and border trade departments.The resumption marks a positive sign in bilateral engagement between India and China. Border trade was formally revived in 2006 after remaining closed since the 1962 India-China conflict and continued uninterrupted until it was suspended in 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The resumption marks a positive sign in bilateral engagement between India and China. Border trade will operate Monday to Thursday, with the gate opening at 7:30 am IST, and each registered trader will be allowed to conduct trade worth up to Rs 2 lakh per day. Officials confirmed that the existing list of approved import and export items and the standard operating procedures remain unchanged.

. US President Donald Trump has threatened to intensify military action against Iran, warning that American strikes will continue until Tehran halts attacks on shipping and returns to negotiations. Kuwait said today that it intercepted and destroyed hostile drones targeting vital facilities and another commercial vessel came under attack in the Strait of Hormuz.The escalating hostilities come as the US State Department issued a fresh security advisory urging Americans in the West Asia to consider leaving the region or be prepared to depart if the conflict worsens.The renewed tensions also spilled into Gaza and Lebanon, with Israel carrying out fresh strikes despite Hamas announcing it was prepared to disarm under a US-backed ceasefire framework.Meanwhile, Iran has warned that it is ready to strike key Israeli infrastructure and American energy facilities across the West Asia if it comes under attack. Iranian State media quoted senior Iranian security official saying Tehran has prepared plans to target critical installations in Israel and US energy assets across the region if any military action is launched against the country.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has congratulated Jadumani Singh Mandengbam on winning the silver medal in the Men’s 55-kilogram boxing event at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow. In a social media post, the Prime Minister said that Jadumani Singh Mandengbam’s success reflects his courage, discipline and perseverance.Mr Modi also congratulated Shubham Juyal on winning the silver medal in the Men’s Shot Put F57 event. The Prime Minister lauded Shubham Juyal’s powerful technique and commitment to the sport. The Prime Minister has congratulated Selva Prabhu Thirumaran on winning the bronze medal in jump at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026.The Prime Minister noted that Selva Prabhu Thirumaran registered a personal best jump to secure the medal. Mr Modi also congratulated Praveen Chithravel on winning the silver medal in the Men’s Triple Jump event at the Commonwealth Games 2026. The Prime Minister expressed delight that Praveen Chithravel also registered the best jump of his sporting career. The Prime Minister wished all the athletes every success in their future endeavours.

. External Affairs Minister Dr Subrahmanyam Jaishankar has said that India has consistently supported the United Nations in strengthening international peace and security. In a written reply in the Lok Sabha today, Dr Jaishankar said, this support has been expressed in a variety of ways, including its unique contribution to UN peacekeeping operations. He said, this contribution is also reflected in India’s membership of the UN Security Council on eight occasions, with the next candidature formally announced for 2028-29. The Minister said, each tenure has witnessed placing issues of Indian interest on the international agenda, the most recent one, in 2021-22, focusing on maritime security and counter-terrorism. He said, the six priorities for the 2028-29 candidature are, A Voice of Global South, Advancing Reformed Multilateralism, A Future Ready Peacekeeping, Addressing threats posed by the misuse of AI, Securing Maritime Commons and Countering Terror Financing.Dr Jaishankar said India is a key contributor to global peace and security, with almost three lakh peacekeepers serving in more than 50 UN missions. He said, currently, four thousand two hundred Indian peacekeepers are deployed in nine out of 11 active missions, working in challenging conditions to promote international peace. The Minister said, India has firmly advanced its view that dialogue and diplomacy are the best means to achieve lasting and durable peace. He said, this has been stated in respect of the Ukraine conflict, the developments in West Asia as well as hostilities in the Gulf. Dr Jaishankar said, with regard to the challenge of terrorism, India has strongly advocated a policy of zero-tolerance and asserted the right of nations to defend themselves against terrorism. He said, since 1996, India has also called for the adoption of a Comprehensive Convention on International Terrorism.

. Benchmark domestic equity indices ended in positive zone for the third consecutive session today. The Sensex rose 166 points or 0.2 percent to close at 78,095. The Nifty added 66 points, or nearly 0.3 percent to settle at 24,384.In the broader market at the National Stock Exchange, the Midcap 100 index as well as the Smallcap 100 index gained over 0.4 percent.Earlier, markets opened on a firm note, and traded in a narrow range during the first half before gaining momentum during the afternoon session.In the Sensex pack, 16 out of 30 companies registered gains. Among the top performers, Bajaj Finance climbed 8.1 per cent, Bajaj Finserv rose 6.6 per cent and Mahindra and Mahindra added 3.6 per cent. In contrast, TCS and Eternal shed over 2.7 per cent, Infosys dipped almost 2.3 per cent and ITC lost one and a half per cent.In the sectoral indices on the BSE, 19 out of 27 sectors ended in positive zone. Among the top gainers, Auto advanced two per cent, Capital Goods rose 1.8 per cent and Industrials gained 1.3 per cent. In contrast, IT lost 1.4 per cent, Focused IT slipped 1.2 per cent, and FMCG fell 0.9 per cent.The overall market breadth at the BSE was positive, as shares of 2 thousand 568 companies advanced, 1 thousand 653 declined, and 204 remained unchanged.

. President Droupadi Murmu has congratulated athlete Tejaswin Shankar on winning the Bronze Medal in the Decathlon at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026. In a social media post, the President described the achievement as a historic first for Indian athletics, as Tejaswin Shankar has become the first Indian to win a Commonwealth Games medal in the decathlon. The President expressed confidence that he will continue to scale new heights of success and bring greater glory to the country.Meanwhile, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has congratulated Tejaswin Shankar on winning the Bronze Medal in the Men’s Decathlon at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026. In a social media post, the Prime Minister Mo lauded Tejaswin Shankar for delivering an exceptional all-round performance across all ten events of the decathlon. He congratulated the athlete on his historic achievement and wished him continued success in the years ahead.

. The Ministry of Tourism and IndiGo have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) today, marking the beginning of a strategic collaboration to promote Incredible India Initiative. In a social media post, Union Culture and Tourism Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat said that India has an extraordinary tourism story to tell, and under this partnership both the Government and IndiGo together are we are taking it to the world. He noted that the MoU marks the beginning of Incredible India by IndiGo, a strategic partnership that will leverage IndiGo’s extensive global network to showcase country’s unparalleled cultural, spiritual, natural and wellness destinations to millions of travelers worldwide.Mr Shekhawat underlined that this collaboration is another step towards strengthening Brand India and making the nation a preferred global tourism destination under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

. Minister for Railways Ashwini Vaishnaw has said that safety is accorded the highest priority on Indian Railways and as a consequence of various safety measures taken over the years, there has been a steep decline in the number of accidents. In a written reply in the Lok Sabha today, Mr Vaishnaw said, after extensive and elaborate trials, Kavach Version 4.0 has been successfully commissioned on two thousand 569 Route Kilometres covering the high density Delhi- Mumbai and Delhi-Howrah routes as on 20th of this month. He informed that the funds utilized on Kavach works so far up to last month is three thousand 874 Crore rupees. Mr Vaishnaw said, the allocation of funds during the year 2026-27 is two thousand 66 crore rupees. He said, Kavach work is going at a good pace in the entire country. The Minister said, specialized training programmes on Kavach are being conducted at centralized training institutes of Indian Railways to impart training to all concerned officials. He said, by now more than 94 thousand technicians, operators and engineers have been trained on Kavach technology. He added that this includes about 57 thousand Loco Pilots and Assistant Loco Pilots.

. Major US indices rallied yesterday, led by gains in chip stocks. The Nasdaq Composite Index jumped 2.8 per cent, ending a six-day losing streak. The S&P 500 rose almost 1.7 per cent and the Dow Jones Industrial Average settled 1.2 per cent higher.Meanwhile, the US economy grew at a slower pace in the second quarter this year. According to the advance estimate released by the US Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), real gross domestic product increased at an annual rate of 1.5 per cent, down from 2.1 per cent in the first quarter.A separate report by the BEA showed that personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rose 3.7 per cent in June on an annual basis, easing from a 4.1 per cent increase in May. On a monthly basis, it contracted by 0.1 per cent, from a rise of 0.5 per cent in May.

. Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare Jagat Prakash Nadda has reviewed the preparedness for the National Eligibility-cum-Entrance Test for Postgraduate (NEET-PG) 2026 to ensure the smooth, secure, transparent and technology-enabled conduct of the examination. The exam is scheduled to be held on the 30th August.During the meeting, the minister assessed the preparedness of the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS), technology partners and other stakeholders involved in conducting the examination. He was briefed on examination logistics, candidate facilitation measures, the security architecture and the technology-driven interventions introduced for NEET-PG 2026.The minister stressed that every effort must be made to ensure a fair, transparent and candidate-friendly examination while upholding the highest standards of integrity and security. Mr Nadda also urged aspirants not to fall prey to rumours and rely only on official communications issued by NBEMS and the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.He highlighted that the final question paper is selected through a highly secure, encrypted and time-bound process shortly before the commencement of the examination, with multiple layers of technological and operational safeguards ensuring its confidentiality until the scheduled start time. The Minister also reviewed the comprehensive security arrangements put in place for the examination. Further, Mr Nadda directed all concerned agencies to maintain close coordination to ensure that every candidate experiences a smooth, secure and hassle-free examination process.According to the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, a total of 2 lakh 73 thousand and 183 candidates have registered for NEET-PG 2026, representing an increase of over 12.5 percent compared to the previous year. The examination will be conducted in a single shift across approximately 340 cities and over 13 hundred examination centres.

. The 135th edition of the Durand Cup Football commenced with a spectacular opening ceremony at the Indira Gandhi Athletic Stadium, Sarusajai in Guwahati today. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued an orange warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall over Karnataka, Kerala, Mahe, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Tripura, Rajasthan, Sub-Himalayan West Bengal and Sikkim today.
